summary: Iteration 4 (Portfolio screen + AI assistant + 6-tab bottom nav) PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases green in test_iter4_ai_portfolio.py — POST /api/ai/chat returns grounded {reply}; multi-turn continuity persists (>=4 messages after 2 turns via GET /api/ai/messages); DELETE /api/ai/messages clears history; POST /api/ai/commentary returns non-empty {commentary, at}; POST /api/ai/portfolio-advice with USD qty=1000 buyPrice=45 returns totalValue matching prices.sell*qty (48.241,00) and totalCost=45.000,00 with meaningful advice; empty-message and empty-portfolio return 400; multi-holding math verified (USD+EUR, no buyPrice → totalCost=0). Regression: GET /api/prices and /api/meta OK. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, https://github-mobile-6.preview.emergentagent.com): 6-tab bar renders correctly (Piyasa/Favoriler/Portföy/Hesapla/Alarmlar/Ayarlar) with active gold tint. Portfolio tab: empty state shows wallet icon + explainer; Varlık Ekle FAB opens sheet, USD default, filled qty=1000 buyPrice=45,00 → save creates row 'Amerikan Doları 1.000,00 × 48,2410 · Maliyet 45,0000' with value 48.241,00 ₺ and green +3.241,00 ₺ (%7,20); summary card testIDs portfolio-total-value + portfolio-total-pl match the row; AI Değerlendirmesi Al opens sheet, shows spinner, then renders 1343-char Turkish advice grounded in real prices (referenced 45,00 maliyet, 48,2410 satış, günlük %-değerler). Assistant flow: sparkles button (open-assistant-btn) in Market header opens /assistant; empty state shows hero + 3 quick actions; typing 'Merhaba, altın alsam mı?' into ai-input and tapping ai-send produces user bubble then assistant reply grounded in current gram/çeyrek altın prices (visible screenshot); assistant-clear empties thread (assistant msgs count 1→0). All expected testIDs present and tappable. No red-screen errors; only pre-existing non-blocking web-only warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations, expo-notifications web listener — already documented in iter2/iter3, unchanged).

action_items: Optional (still carried over): migrate shadow*/pointerEvents style props to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents for web to silence deprecation warnings.
Native binary required to validate alarm sound + push (out of scope for this iteration per problem statement).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1027 lines — well past the 700-line split guideline; recommend splitting into modules (ai, poller, alarms, prices, admin, auth) before next iteration.

AI endpoints correctly ground responses in market_snapshot_text() with fmt_tr + günlük % change; multi-turn history is fed back as system-message transcript (last 10 msgs) — reliable continuity confirmed.

ai_portfolio_advice math uses published sell price via compute_price() (same as GET /api/prices) — matches what the UI shows, so totals stay consistent between frontend PortfolioContext computation and backend advice response.
AI endpoints correctly return 400 for empty message / empty portfolio, and 502 (rather than raw 500) on LlmChat failures — good UX.
GET/DELETE /api/ai/messages properly scoped by deviceId; excludes MongoDB _id from response (returns only role/content/ts).
Portfolio storage is local-only (AsyncStorage via PortfolioContext) per spec — no backend persistence needed; advice request sends full holdings payload on demand, which is the correct pattern.
assistant.tsx clears local state before awaiting DELETE — safe optimistic UX; potential slight inconsistency if delete fails, but low risk (idempotent DELETE).
portfolio-buyprice placeholder uses formatNumber(asset.sell, dec) — nice UX hint with current price.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 iter4 AI + Portfolio advice tests + prices/meta regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Portfolio create/summary/advice + AI chat send/receive/clear + 6-tab nav all verified)
